'''Silver ore''' can be mined from [[Silver vein]]s found in [[Mountain]] biomes above 120m using an [[Iron pickaxe]] or better. The ore can be smelted into [[Silver]] using a [[Smelter]].

== Location ==
Silver veins can be found using the [[Wishbone]] obtained from [[Bonemass]].

Alternatively, hitting the ground with a two-handed hammer like [[Stagbreaker]] or the [[Iron sledge]] may reveal underground silver deposits through the "too hard" message that appears when a silver vein is in the damage area of the two-handed club.

Trenching your positions may inadvertently reveal silver veins, provided you are above 120 meters in elevation. Despite the ground appearing frozen, it is no more difficult to dig in the Mountains than in other biomes, so hitting a vein by sheer luck is not out of the question.

== Notes ==
* Like other metals, {{PAGENAME}} cannot be teleported without a [[Portal stone]].
* If Drakes and Obsidian (100m for both) are spawning near the player, they are close to the height needed (120m) for Silver to spawn.
* [[Cart|Carts]] may be difficult to use in the Mountains due to the slopes but can be useful to help reduce further trips.
* Silver ore is the heaviest ore of all the ore types.
* Cannot be broken by Stone Golem or [[Antler pickaxe]].
